question: 三个固定价格风险候选能否帮助判断未来20个收盘间隔的最大收盘亏损，以及相对现有信息增加多少

vol_instability20.formula: simple returns r_t=100*(C_t/C_(t-1)-1); v5_t=sample std(r_(t-4)..r_t, ddof=1); X=sample std(v5_(t-19)..v5_t,ddof=1)/mean(v5_(t-19)..v5_t); mean<=1e-12 -> missing

beta_asymmetry60.formula: 60 aligned simple return pairs target vs 510300.SS; separately OLS slopes with intercept for anchor r<0 and r>0; minimum10 each, conditional variance>1e-12; X=beta_down-beta_up; anchor never itself predicted

negative_cluster60.formula: last60 returns give59 transitions; neg = r<0, zero nonnegative; X=P(current neg|previous neg)-P(current neg|previous nonneg); minimum5 transitions for each previous state else missing

population: All four source ETFs retained in scheduled denominator; 510300 anchor observations explicitly excluded in all three tests for common comparison. All candidates and baseline complete on a common date/asset set; 252 contiguous known-OHLC warmup; gap resets both synchronized series.
S_E: exact local_features(close,20) seeded EMA/SMA states; reuse existing formula, not new trade states
baseline_details: returns percentage points; volatility sample std ddof1 nonannualized; downside_rms60=sqrt(mean(min(r,0)^2)); autocorrelation uses Pearson of adjacent 59 returns; current_negative_run counts within60; beta60 intercept OLS on60 paired simple returns; relative_return20=own compounded return20 minus anchor return20.

models.core: B1 fixed ridge lambda1 on baseline18 vs B2 baseline+one candidate
models.solo: B1 asset510500/588000 identity only vs B2 identity+one candidate; B0 global training mean provided by evaluator

evaluation: MSE primary, RMSE auxiliary; equal-asset weights, fixed common support. Improvement=B1 MSE-B2 MSE; positive better. No invented meaningful-effect threshold; exploratory historical research.
checks: hand calculations and price scale invariance
